name: Warlord
theme: Apotheosis of the Finisher. Threshold rises, execute range doubles, Bloodied bosses melt at the first heavy strike.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Rage Threshold raises to 50% HP. Execute-range skills gain +100% damage instead of +50%.'
Pairs with berserker.json warlord path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone King of Ruin + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Slam Mastery.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 6 of 8 wireable today. Bloodied combo state (signature class-tree mechanic) is approximated via whileTag(bleed) damageMult — Berserker auto-applies bleed via §8.3 ailment baseline, so the conditional fires correctly in combat. Threshold Push (Rage Threshold +5% HP) and King of Ruin capstone (threshold raise to 50% + execute +100%) are decorative until Phase F lands the Rage Threshold mechanic.

nodes.name: Bloodlust Tempo
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% attack speed (foundation tempo for the execute window).

nodes.name: Threshold Hunter
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to Bleeding enemies (foundation Bloodied-target scaler — bleed is the §8.3 baseline ailment for the path).

nodes.name: Bloodbath
nodes.description: On crit, +1/2/3/4/5% chance to apply 2 Bleed stacks instead of the base 1 (deepens the Bloodied stack engine).

nodes.name: Threshold Push
nodes.description: Rage Threshold raises by +5% HP (Frenzied window opens earlier).

nodes.name: Slam Mastery
nodes.description: +5/10/15% crit damage (foundation amplifier — pairs with Bloodied-target scaling).

nodes.name: Apex Predator
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage to Bleeding enemies (deeper Bloodied scaling — stacks with Threshold Hunter).

nodes.name: King of Ruin
nodes.description: Rage Threshold raises to 65% HP (from base 50%). Execute-range skills (those gaining bonuses below threshold) deal +100% damage instead of +50%. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
